subject: Request: evaluation credits + short trial extension for FinServ AI RFP
messages:
From: Danielle Ortiz <d.ortiz@finserv.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finserv.ai
Date: Sun, 5 Dec 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: RFP: request for branded eval credits and short extension

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the call earlier — FinServ AI is finalizing materials for an RFP closing next week. We'd like to include Redwood in a competitive benchmark across latency and cost metrics. Procurement asked whether Redwood can provide an allotment of hosted eval credits (roughly 250k tokens + 3 dedicated evaluation sessions) and a two-week trial extension to align with our internal testing window.

Can you confirm whether that's feasible and if there are any standard terms we should review? We will include the credit amount in the scoring matrix and would like the evaluation environment to be stable (no model changes) for the test window.

Attached is the RFP scope doc. Happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Danielle Ortiz
Head of Platform Strategy | FinServ AI
Attachments: FinServ_RFP_scope.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Ortiz <d.ortiz@finserv.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 5 Dec 2027 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP: request for branded eval credits and short extension

Danielle —

Appreciate the RFP. We're interested and can typically support a competitive eval like this. I want to confirm internal approvals and a small legal/ops checklist (stable model pinning, limited SLA for the eval environment, and a credit-agreement).

Internal team — looping in Priya (success) and Jonas (revenue ops) to get approvals on the credit size + trial extension. Quick ask: can we do 250k hosted eval tokens + 2 dedicated evaluation sessions (2 x 4-hour reserved windows) and a two-week extension on the trial? Also need approval to pin the model to a specific Redwood-verified variant for the test window.

I'll hold on comms to procurement until we get internal sign-off.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 08:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: request for branded eval credits and short extension

Team —

Quick notes from a success/CS perspective: 250k tokens is reasonable for a 2-week benchmark if we pair it with two scheduled reserved sessions so the customer has repeatable load tests. Requirements:
- Pin to model variant: rdx-m3-stable-1
- No infra/major model changes during the window
- We provide an eval runbook + scoring template (I can draft)

Risks: if the RFP becomes public, we should add a clause preventing disclosure of internal performance metadata for the first 30 days. Also recommend we require signature on a short credit-agreement to avoid misuse.

Happy to lead the runbook and coordinate the two reserved windows with infra.

—Priya
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: request for branded eval credits and short extension

SEAN/PRIYA —

I've reviewed from a revenue ops perspective. Approve up to 300k hosted eval tokens for this RFP (so 250k is within range) with the following guardrails:
- Credits expire 30 days after allocation unless otherwise extended in writing
- Credit use limited to the evaluation deployment (we'll tag the tenant)
- Customer must sign the credit-agreement (attached template) and confirm they will not run production workloads on it
- No discounting changes to the commercial offer as part of this promotion (we keep pricing conversations separate)

Evelyn, I can sign off on this if you confirm we can absorb the token burn into Q4 promotional allowances.

Jonas
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: request for branded eval credits and short extension

All — approved. Confirming:
- 275,000 hosted eval tokens allocated (compromise between ask and buffer)
- Two reserved evaluation sessions (2 x 4-hour windows) scheduled via SE team; SE to confirm exact times with FinServ AI
- Two-week trial extension from the date credits are activated; we will pin to rdx-m3-stable-1 for the window
- Customer must sign the credit-agreement and accept the evaluation runbook; credits will be tagged and expire 30 days after activation

Sean — you have approval to proceed to procurement and send the credit package. Priya, please own the runbook and session scheduling; Jonas, please attach the credit-agreement template.

Evelyn Hart
VP Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 16:59:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood: Eval credits and trial extension for FinServ AI (next steps)

Danielle —

Thanks for the patience. We can support the RFP benchmark. Summary of what Redwood will provide: 
- 275,000 hosted eval tokens allocated to a tagged evaluation tenant
- Two reserved evaluation sessions (2 x 4-hour windows) — SE will propose times
- Two-week trial extension from the activation date
- Model pinned to rdx-m3-stable-1 for the duration of the test window

Next steps for you:
1) Sign the attached credit-agreement template (simple 1-pager)
2) Confirm preferred time windows for the reserved sessions
3) We will activate credits upon receipt of the signed agreement and share the eval runbook + access link: https://app.redwood.com/deployments/eval/finserv-2027

Attachments included: credit-agreement-template.pdf, eval-environment-instructions.txt

Happy to join the kickoff call when you have availability.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachments: credit-agreement-template.pdf, eval-environment-instructions.txt
